intro.fr: XCOM: Enemy Unknown a un mod qui rend sa couche tactique plus aléatoire.
intro.en: XCOM: Enemy Unknown has a mod that makes its tactical layer more random.

text.fr: Firaxis Games sort XCOM: Enemy Unknown en 2012.
text.en: Firaxis Games releases XCOM: Enemy Unknown in 2012.

text.fr: Le 30 septembre 2014, wghost81 publie sur Nexus Mods XCOM Randomized, qui rend les missions tactiques plus aléatoires que dans le jeu de base ; la version 4.0 date de juillet 2015.
text.en: On September 30, 2014, wghost81 posts XCOM Randomized on Nexus Mods, which makes tactical missions more random than in the base game; version 4.0 dates from July 2015.
